def test_rejects_future_posted_on():
    with open("fixtures/ledger_400.json") as f:
        records = json.load(f)
    record = dict(records[0], posted_on="2026-03-02")
    with pytest.raises(ImportRejected, match=r"^posted_on is in the future$"):
        import_record(record, TODAY)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("posted_on", ["2026-02-28", "2026-03-01"])
def test_imports_posted_on_or_before_today(posted_on):
    with open("fixtures/ledger_400.json") as f:
        records = json.load(f)
    record = dict(records[0], posted_on=posted_on)
    entry = import_record(record, TODAY)
    assert entry.posted_on == date.fromisoformat(posted_on)
    assert entry.account == record["account"]
    assert entry.amount == Decimal(record["amount"])
    assert entry.memo == record["memo"]
